name: Senpuuji Kyouko
source:
"Huh, you going to do it or not?" 

 A woman who won the name of the Legendary Ladies. She's an old friend of the head of Gokuren, Idagawa Ren, but due to certain circumstances their relationship is quite rocky. She's had many experiences in life, and is very mature. A widow. 

 Battle quote - "That is something I cannot tolerate!"
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
